versions.content: function Flush [SWS_LOG_00039] Upstream: RS_LT_00003 , RS_LT_00049 void Flush () noexcept; Sends out the current log buffer and initiates a new message stream. Note: Calling ara::log::LogStream::Flush is only necessary if the ara::log::LogStream object is going to be re-used within the same scope. Otherwise, if the object goes out of scope (e.g. end of function block) then the flushing operation will be done internally by the destructor. It is important to note that the ara::log::LogStream::Flush command does not empty the buffer, but it forwards the buffer’s current contents to the Logging framework.
